title: Consultor de Vendas Campinas
description:
Vaga: Consultor(a) de Vendas Sênior (Educação) - Campinas/SP

A Oportunidade

Estamos em um momento de forte expansão, com escolas na região de Campinas, e buscamos vendedores sênior para se juntarem à nossa equipe de alta performance. Se você é um profissional apaixonado por educação, movido por desafios e com um histórico comprovado de sucesso em vendas consultivas, esta é a sua chance de crescer conosco e causar um impacto real na vida de centenas de famílias.

Nossa missão é transformar o futuro através de uma educação de excelência, acessível e inovadora. Procuramos pessoas que não apenas queiram vender, mas que acreditem no poder da educação e queiram construir relacionamentos duradouros com nossos clientes.

Suas Responsabilidades

Como Consultor(a) de Vendas Sênior, você será a ponte entre as famílias e a nossa proposta pedagógica. Suas principais responsabilidades serão:


• Gestão Completa do Ciclo de Vendas: Desde a prospecção ativa de novos clientes (pais, alunos, empresas parceiras) até a negociação e o fechamento de matrículas.


• Vendas Consultivas: Entender profundamente as necessidades e os anseios de cada família para apresentar a solução educacional que melhor se encaixe em seu perfil, atuando como um verdadeiro consultor.


• Construção de Relacionamento: Criar e nutrir um relacionamento de confiança e de longo prazo com a comunidade escolar, garantindo a satisfação e a fidelização dos nossos alunos.


• Prospecção Estratégica: Participar de eventos, feiras e desenvolver parcerias locais para fortalecer a marca da escola e gerar novas oportunidades de negócio.


• Atingimento de Metas: Trabalhar com foco em resultados, buscando atingir e superar as metas de vendas individuais e da equipe.

O que Buscamos em Você

Para esta posição, esperamos que você tenha:


• Experiência Comprovada: Sólida experiência em vendas, preferencialmente no setor de serviços, educação ou em vendas B2C de ticket médio/alto.


• Habilidades de Negociação: Maestria em técnicas de negociação, contorno de objeções e fechamento de vendas.


• Comunicação Excepcional: Capacidade de se comunicar de forma clara, persuasiva e empática, criando uma conexão genuína com os clientes.


• Perfil Comportamental: Ser uma pessoa proativa, organizada, resiliente e com uma forte orientação para resultados. Acreditamos que a atitude certa é tão importante quanto a experiência.


• Localização: Residir em Campinas ou região metropolitana.

O que oferecemos

Reconhecemos e valorizamos nossos talentos. Por isso, oferecemos um pacote de remuneração e benefícios competitivo:


• Remuneração Fixa: Salário de R$ 2.500,00.


• Comissionamento Agressivo: Um plano de comissões transparente e sem teto, com potencial de ganhos mensais que podem ultrapassar R$ 12.000,00, baseado no seu desempenho.


• Crescimento Profissional: Oportunidade real de desenvolvimento de carreira em uma empresa em plena expansão.


• Desenvolvimento Contínuo: Treinamentos constantes sobre nossos serviços, técnicas de vendas e desenvolvimento pessoal.


• Ambiente de Trabalho: Uma cultura que valoriza a colaboração, a inovação e o alto desempenho.

Como se candidatar

Se você se identificou com esta oportunidade e acredita que tem o perfil para fazer parte do nosso time, envie seu currículo para o nosso WhatsApp:

  • Comunicar à coordenação qualquer ocorrência relevante.
  • Colaborar com professores, coordenação e demais funcionários.
HABILIDADES, QUALIFICAÇÕES E EXPERIÊNCIAS:

  • Capacidade de lidar com crianças e adolescentes com empatia e autoridade.
  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar em período integral.
INFORMAÇÕES DA VAGA:
Salário: 1.900,00 Vale-Alimentação: 250,00 Horário: A combinar. 44 horas semanais.  Benefícios: Unimed coparticipativa, Uniodonto mensal em valor de R$20,00; TotalPass.  Compromisso com os Princípios de Salvaguarda
O Colégio Progresso está empenhado em salvaguardar e promover o bem-estar das crianças e jovens estudantes, e espera que todos os colaboradores e voluntários partilhem deste compromisso.
Todas as pessoas titulares de qualquer função ou cargo estão sujeitos a procedimentos de verificação apropriados, incluindo uma pesquisa para devida diligência, referências profissionais cobrindo o histórico dos últimos 10 anos e verificações de antecedentes criminais satisfatórias (atendendo ao art. 59A Lei no 8069 de 13 de julho de 1990 do Estatuto da Criança e do Adolescente).   Compromisso com a Diversidade, Equidade, Inclusão e Pertencimento
O Colégio Progresso está empenhado em fortalecer a nossa cultura inclusive, identificando, contratando, desenvolvendo e retendo colegas de equipe de alto desempenho, independentemente do gênero, raça, orientação sexual, expressão de gênero, idade, deficiência, neuro divergência, origem socioeconômica e/ou outras características demográficas. As pessoas candidatas que compartilham com a nossa visão e princípios, e estão interessados em contribuir para o sucesso da escola através desta função são fortemente encorajadas a candidatar-se à vaga.

title: Técnico(a) Enfermagem
description:
Em 2017, a Companhia realizou seu primeiro investimento ao adquirir o Vera Cruz Hospital, localizado na cidade Campinas-SP, que com mais de 80 anos de atuação, é um dos mais tradicionais hospitais da cidade. O hospital atualmente conta com 11 salas cirúrgicas, 08 Leitos de Apoio Cirúrgico, 110 leitos de internação, 14 leitos de UTI Adulto, 10 leitos de Unidade Cardiológica, 10 leitos Semi-intensiva, 16 leitos Maternidade/Alojamento Conjunto, 09 leitos Pediatria e Pronto Socorro 24h. Além de atender mais de 66 especialidades, ter acreditação ONA 3 e ter conquistado em 2025 a importantíssima acreditação da JCI.

Desde então, por meio do Vera Cruz Hospital, aumentamos nossa rede de forma substancial em Campinas e região. Com a inauguração, por exemplo, de serviços novos como os Centros de Oncologia, Neurologia, Cardiologia, Ortopedia, a Unidade de Atenção Primária da Saúde e a criação das unidades avançadas em Indaiatuba.

Além disso, realizamos também a aquisição da Casa de Saúde Campinas, um dos hospitais mais importantes da história da cidade, localizado em um prédio centenário, parte do acervo arquitetônico da cidade. Nesse mesmo processo de consolidação regional, adquirimos também a operadora de saúde Vera Cruz, atualmente denominada 2Care.

A regional faz parte do grupo Hospital Care que em 2017, a união das pessoas com o sonho de transformar a saúde suplementar do Brasil, possibilitou o início da trajetória da companhia. Somos uma holding administradora de serviços de saúde que propõe um modelo inovador de gestão integrada, tendo como objetivo promover o equilíbrio de interesses entre pacientes, médicos, fontes pagadoras, parceiros e acionistas. Para isso, conta com um sistema de saúde completo com hospitais de alta complexidade, laboratórios de exames, planos de saúde e centros médicos.

Como estratégia de atuação, está presente em cidades que funcionam como polos regionais para a gestão de saúde, dentro de três estados, São Paulo, Paraná e Florianópolis. Esse conjunto de operações tem como objetivo nos tornar a melhor Rede de Prestadores de Saúde Privada do Brasil.

title: Senior Clinical Research Analyst
description:
Zoetis values and supports inclusion, upholding equal opportunities.

Location: Campinas (SP)

Role Description

Responsible for coordinating and tracking, with coaching and support, research & development clinical studies for biologicals projects in compliance with appropriate regulatory requirements and internal policies. Effectively collaborates with the cross-functional development team (regional research and development team VMRD- Brazil) to support new products licensing in Brazil and Latin America. The position is based in Campinas - São Paulo with frequent interactions with colleagues and external partners located around Brazil, requiring availability to travel.

Responsibilities

1.  Assistance to all study activities, including start up, investigator training, study conduct, site monitoring and close out. These may include, but are not limited to:

CRO selection and training.

To ensure the execution of clinical studies in compliance with good clinical practices, animal welfare and applied legislation

Assisting in preparation of study protocols, data capture forms, electronic data capture, test article documentation and study reports

Maintaining study files in accordance with Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and regulatory requirements

Assisting in data management processes including data review, tracking and verification

Serve as a communication link between the sponsor and study site, including study site monitoring activities which require ability to travel regularly and independently (short periods of 1-3 days).

2. Provide support for the elaboration/review of quality assurance clinical documents.

3. Provide support to departmental colleagues

4. Collectively responsible for the timely deliverables of new products in Brazil.

He/she will interact with other VMRD colleagues (locally and globally) such as Project Team Leaders, Biometricians, Data Managers and other areas as Regulatory Affairs and Commercial.

Requirements

  • Degree in Veterinary Medicine or other relevant biological field (e.g. biology, animal science, etc);
  • A MSc and/or PhD could be an advantage
  • Solid  experience with veterinary clinical research studies;
  • Demonstrate good inter-personal communication and presentation skills as this position will interact with other teams and all level of management;
  • Good written and oral command of Portuguese and English language (A strong ability in scientific writing could be an advantage);
  • Availability to travel (short periods of 1-3 days) and holds a driver license (category B).

O Atacado Vila Nova foi fundado por Pedro Severini Netto, em 1928, com o nome de Empório União na cidade de Monte Azul Paulista-SP, estamos há mais de 90 anos no mercado construindo uma história de sucesso e crescimento exponencial.

Estamos em busca de indivíduos apaixonados pela aprendizagem contínua, que buscam ir além e se superar a cada dia. Acreditamos que nosso sucesso é fruto das pessoas que fazem parte da nossa equipe e, por isso, valorizamos a diversidade e inclusão, seja ela de origens, culturas, crenças, experiências, gêneros e gerações. title: Senior DevSecOps Engineer
description:
1GLOBAL is a technology-driven global mobile communications leader, built to help enterprises unlock the full potential of mobile connectivity at scale. Powered by a best-in-class telecom platform – including our own owned and operated global mobile core network, a full end-to-end eSIM technology stack, and an extensive portfolio of telecom licenses – 1GLOBAL operates as a fully regulated telecommunications provider across 40 countries worldwide. Combined with our privileged access to the global wholesale telecom market, this positions us uniquely to deliver seamless, compliant, and scalable connectivity solutions anywhere in the world.  

We serve many of the world's leading banks, enterprises, and digital-first businesses, including neo-banks, fast moving consumer goods companies, travel leaders, and payment service providers. Today, 1GLOBAL connects more than 70 million people and devices globally, enabling our customers to launch, scale, and innovate with confidence in the mobile ecosystem.  

1GLOBAL is a profitable, fast-growing business. With full-year revenues exceeding US$200 million and profits of over US$25 million, we generate strong cash flows and fund our growth independently—continuously investing in infrastructure, platform innovation, and global expansion. Recent years have marked a defining phase in our journey, with major enterprise and mass-consumer client wins accelerating our evolution into a global mobile connectivity powerhouse, purpose-built to enable consumer brands to enter and succeed with their own telecommunications offerings.  

Founded in 2022 by experienced technology entrepreneurs Hakan Koç and Pyrros Koussios, 1GLOBAL has rapidly emerged as a European technology leader shaping the future of global telecommunications. We operate as a fully regulated Mobile Virtual Network Operator (MVNO) in 12 countries and as a regulated telecom operator in an additional 28 markets. Headquartered in the Netherlands, with world-class R&D hubs in Lisbon, Berlin, and São Paulo, our team of close to 500 experts across 15 countries is united by a single ambition: to redefine global mobile connectivity through technology, scale, and execution excellence. 

Position Overview

We are looking for a talented Senior DevSecOps / Cloud Security Engineer to join our Technology Department, with a focus on strengthening and automating our security posture across cloud and hybrid infrastructure. 

As a DevSecOps / Cloud Security Engineer, you will be responsible for embedding security into every stage of our infrastructure lifecycle, from design to deployment. You will lead the implementation of cloud-native security controls in AWS, harden Kubernetes environments, and drive best practices across CI/CD pipelines. Your role includes continuous vulnerability management, network protection, monitoring for threats, and working with development, DevOps and IP teams to ensure secure-by-default practices. You'll also proactively identify risks, secure network perimeters, and automate remediation wherever possible. 
The successfully hired candidate will receive onboarding and training in Lisbon, Portugal; gaining valuable skills while experiencing one of Europe's most dynamic and renowned cities.
Fluency in English is essential for this role. Please ensure your CV is submitted in English as part of your application.

Key responsibilities

  • Design, implement, and evolve scalable cloud security controls across AWS multi-account environments using security-as-code principles 
  • Own Kubernetes security architecture including workload isolation, RBAC, pod security standards, and network segmentation 
  • Embed security automation into CI/CD pipelines, including image scanning, IaC validation, and policy enforcement 
  • Continuously assess cloud and Kubernetes environments for vulnerabilities, misconfigurations, and emerging threats 
  • Design and maintain strong IAM and secrets management practices, enforcing least-privilege access 
  • Partner with DevOps, Platform, and IP/Network teams to deliver security controls as code and by design 
  • Analyze network traffic and security telemetry using flow logs, metrics, and targeted packet inspection where required 
  • Ensure alignment with internal security policies and external frameworks (CIS, NIST, ISO 27001, etc.) 
  • Produce and maintain clear documentation, including security architectures, runbooks, and incident response playbooks 
  • Act as a security champion, driving best practices, awareness, and secure engineering culture across teams 

Requirements

  • A minimum of 3+ years Cloud Security / DevSecOps / Infrastructure Security 
  • Strong AWS security fundamentals (IAM, KMS, GuardDuty, Config, Security Hub) 
  • Solid Linux security and cloud networking fundamentals 
  • Hands-on Kubernetes security (RBAC, NetworkPolicies, pod security, image scanning) 
  • Infrastructure as Code (Terraform) and Git-based workflows 
  • Scripting for automation (Python or Go or Bash) 
  • Experience with vulnerability management and container security 
  • Security-first mindset with strong troubleshooting skills 
  • Experience with WAFs and cloud DDoS protection 
  • Comfortable with packet inspection, flow analysis, and traffic monitoring (tcpdump, Wireshark, Suricata, etc.) 

Benefits

What we offer?

  • CLT contract — enjoy job stability and reliable benefits that value your work
  • Quarterly performance bonuses to reward your hard work and achievements
  • Meal allowance paid into Caju card — R$100 per working day
  • Extended parental leave - 180 days of maternity leave and 20 days of paternity leave.
  • Health insurance with SulAmérica — 50% covered by the company
  • Daycare allowance provided to mothers with children under 3 years old — R$500 per month per child
  • Kickstart your journey with an exciting welcome onboarding trip to one of our European offices (Lisbon or Berlin)

Why 1GLOBAL?

  • Growth Opportunities: Advance your career in one of the fastest growing telecommunications companies, expanding over 100% year-on-year under the leadership of successful tech entrepreneurs.
  • Major Transaction Exposure: Be in the driver's seat for transactions that will have an impact on the future telco industry.
  • Work with a Talented Team: From the Board and the Founders to the Senior Management Team, you will collaborate daily with the most capable and renowned external advisors, and constantly being exposed to talented and driven individuals.
  • Dynamic Work Environment: Thrive in a collaborative, fast-paced workplace where innovation is encouraged, and every contribution counts.
  • Professional Development: Work alongside industry experts to enhance your skills and knowledge in a cutting-edge field.
  • International Experience: Gain opportunities to work in different 1GLOBAL offices around the world as you grow within the company.
  • Open Communication Culture: Join a team where your ideas are heard, and open dialogue is encouraged, fostering a supportive and transparent work environment.
  • Get Things Done Attitude: Be part of a results-driven team that values efficiency, creativity, and the drive to make a tangible impact in the industry.


1GLOBAL is an equal opportunity employer, we value your character as much as your talent. Diversity drives our innovation, and we offer a collaborative, dynamic, and international work environment. We are excited for you to join our mission to revolutionise connectivity globally.

description:

Responsabilidades

Requisitos

  • Experiência prévia na área fiscal.
  • Conhecimento em CFOP e classificação fiscal de operações.
  • Conhecimento básico ou intermediário em ICMS, ISS, impostos retidos e documentos fiscais eletrônicos.

  • Conhecimento em Pacote Office (principalmente Excel).
  • Desejável: Conhecimento no ERP Datasul ou outro ERP de mercado.

Diferenciais

  • Experiência com apuração de ICMS, envio de SPED Fiscal e GIA.
  • Vivência com processos de faturamento e integração fiscal/logística.
  • Noções de regimes tributários (Lucro Real, Presumido).
  • Capacidade de atuar com grande volume de documentos fiscais.
  • Familiaridade com CRM Sphere ou sistemas similares.

Benefícios:

Assistência Médica, Assistência Odontológica, Vale Alimentação, Refeição, Seguro de Vida, Gympass, PLR, acesso a plataforma de Idiomas GoFluent.

Programa de Apoio Optum: Em parceria com a Ifood, para orientação psicológica e social extensivo aos familiares, sem custo ao Colaborador, com acesso mediante contato telefônico.

A Sonepar é uma empresa que oferece oportunidades iguais e convida mulheres, minorias visíveis e indivíduos com deficiência a se candidatarem. Acreditamos que a diversidade impulsiona nossos resultados e cria um ambiente de trabalho que favorece a inovação, interação e melhores oportunidades de carreira.

Todos os candidatos qualificados serão avaliados para oportunidades de emprego com base em seus méritos, sem discriminação por motivo de raça, cor, religião, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, origem nacional ou deficiência.

title: Inside Technical Sales
description:
Toradex is a global company strongly focused on engineering & technology. We're powered by a diverse & uniquely gifted workforce. We pursue the best people to propel our innovative vision of embedded computing and IoT. If you're interested in being a driving force at an agile technology company, engineering clever computing solutions & helping other companies bring their products to life, we should talk.

Mission


Toradex is seeking a highly motivated Technical Sales Intern to join our global sales team, working remotely from our Brazil Office and supporting the Technical Sales Teams in the USA region. This is a unique opportunity to start your career in technical sales, gaining hands-on experience with cutting-edge embedded computing solutions while supporting our international sales teams.

The internship will run until the end of 2026, offering valuable exposure to the fast-growing field of embedded systems and sales processes. Successful candidates will have the opportunity to be considered for a full-time position upon completion of the internship.

Roles & Responsibilities

  • Support the field sales team by managing leads, assisting with quotations, and conducting follow-ups.
  • Assist in prospecting new clients and maintaining relationships with existing customers.
  • Help maintain and update the Customer Relationship Management (CRM) system with relevant information.
  • Collaborate with international sales teams to drive customer success in USA and EMEA regions.
  • Learn and assist with sales processes, market research, and customer inquiries.
  • Participate in team meetings, provide input, and contribute to sales strategy discussions.

Requirements

  • Currently pursuing a degree in one the fields below:
    • technical field (such as Engineering, Information Technology, or related areas) or
    • business administration area with focus on sales
  • Advanced English proficiency is mandatory – both written and spoken.
  • Available for 30 hours/week from Toradex Office in Campinas/SP
  • Strong communication and organizational skills.
  • Ability to work in a team and adapt to a fast-paced working environment.
  • Interest in embedded computing, IoT, or technical solutions is a strong advantage.

Important information before you apply

  • The whole process, including interviews, will be conducted in English. When submitting your resume, please make sure you select the English version before you submit.
  • The internship location is Campinas/SP – Brazil.

Benefits

  • Competitive Scholarship
  • Meal Voucher
  • Total Pass

and most importantly...

  • Opportunity to develop essential skills in technical sales and customer relationship management.
  • Hands-on training and mentorship from experienced professionals in the embedded computing industry.
  • Potential for full-time employment upon successful completion of the internship.
  • A dynamic, supportive, and international work environment.

Toradex is a leader in embedded computing, serving innovative products to industrial, medical, automotive & IoT companies creating feature-rich & intelligent systems for demanding applications, e.g. supercars, self-driving tractors, patient monitoring systems – to name a few.

We provide effective & robust embedded computing solutions and strive for the best development experience in the industry with a focus on intelligent hardware design, innovative software solutions & free comprehensive support. Our relationship with our customers ensures that we all succeed and it allows us to participate in the realization of incredible new products. Our products are directly sold to more than 3'000 industrial customers in over 70 different countries worldwide.

description:
Descrição da vaga

O Analista de Desenvolvimento apoiará a criação, melhoria e execução de programas de treinamento, contribuindo para a experiência do usuário nos processos de aprendizagem. Esse cargo atuará como um elo entre as áreas técnica, de negócios e de usuários, sempre focando em soluções inovadoras, excelência operacional e alinhamento com a Estratégia e Cultura da Empresa.

  • Apoiar a integração de tecnologias e plataformas de aprendizagem, buscando inovação, eficiência e alinhamento com as melhores práticas do mercado.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Bacharelado concluído.
  • Experiência em produção, edição e gerenciamento de conteúdo de aprendizagem em vários formatos (cursos online, vídeos, apresentações, elementos interativos).
  • Familiaridade com sistemas de tecnologia de aprendizagem (LMS/LXP) e ferramentas de criação (por exemplo, Articulate, Adobe Captivate).
  • Habilidades analíticas para análise de dados e relatórios.

  • Mentalidade inovadora, foco no usuário e comprometido com a melhoria contínua.

OLÁ, SOMOS A AMBEV TECH

Isso mesmo, o Hub de Tecnologia da Ambev
Somos responsáveis por impulsionar a transformação digital da Ambev. O match perfeito entre o portfólio da maior cervejaria do mundo e soluções de Data & Analytics, Cibersegurança, Infraestrutura, Suporte, Field, Engenharia e Arquitetura de Software. Contamos com cerca de 50 Squads, que atuam em mais de 100 produtos, e cada linha de código criada aqui conecta nossa paixão por tecnologia aos mais diversos brindes e suas razões.

Do campo ao copo, entregamos soluções simples e escaláveis usando tecnologia de ponta para transformar o dia a dia de milhares de pessoas. E isso só é possível graças a um time incrível que faz acontecer, com inovação, senso de dono e muito orgulho de ser tech.

PROTAGONIZAMOS SOLUÇÕES GLOBAIS
Muitas das nossas soluções são escaladas para a
Ambev Global Tech
, hub de tecnologia da Anheuser-Busch InBev (AB InBev), multinacional de bebidas e cervejas, e para outras unidades de negócio da companhia. Com escritórios espalhados por países como Estados Unidos, México, Índia, Argentina e Brasil, estamos conectados a uma rede global de inovação e tecnologia para transformar a Ambev em uma plataforma que conecta pessoas e o ecossistema.

NOSSO JEITO TECH DE SER
Por aqui, sonhamos grande e sabemos a importância de ter equipes cada vez mais diversas. É através da pluralidade de ideias, experiências e opiniões que conseguimos pensar fora da caixa e criar soluções inovadoras. Por isso, contamos com nosso Comitê de Autenticidade Tech para olhar com muito carinho e responsabilidade todas as questões relacionadas à inclusão.

QUER TRABALHAR COM A GENTE?
Para atuar na
Ambev Tech
com projetos nacionais, temos unidades em Blumenau (SC), Maringá (PR), São Paulo (SP) e Jaguariúna (SP), e contamos também com um time remoto em vários cantos do Brasil e América Latina. , a contratação acontece no modelo presencial, em Campinas (SP).

title: Business Analytics Intern
description:
Toradex
is a global company strongly focused on engineering & technology. We're powered by a diverse & uniquely gifted workforce. We pursue the best people to propel our innovative vision of embedded computing and IoT. If you're interested in being a driving force at an agile technology company, engineering clever computing solutions & helping other companies bring their products to life, we should talk.

About Toradex & Torizon Cloud
Toradex helps customers build embedded products faster with System on Modules and a strong software ecosystem.
Torizon Cloud
is part of our platform strategy—supporting device lifecycle management and secure operations for embedded Linux devices.

Your mission

As a
Business Analytics Intern
, you'll help the Torizon Cloud Sales team run with speed and precision. Your focus will be improving how we handle
leads and opportunities
, increasing data quality, and building reporting automation so the team can make better decisions with less manual effort.

What you'll do

  • Optimize lead & opportunity flow: review current processes, identify bottlenecks, propose improvements, and help implement changes
  • CRM hygiene & process consistency: help ensure leads/opportunities are created, updated, and progressed correctly
  • Reporting & automation: build and automate dashboards and recurring reports (pipeline, conversion rates, lead sources, velocity, sales forecasting, etc.)
  • Data analysis: spot anomalies, trends, and gaps; translate findings into actionable recommendations
  • Documentation: create simple, structured process documentation (SOPs), definitions, and checklists
  • Cross-functional support (optional): contribute to Marketing Ops initiatives such as lead scoring, campaign attribution, lifecycle stages, and data enrichment

What we're looking for

  • Currently studying in a relevant field (e.g., Engineering, Computer Science, Business Analytics, Information Systems, Economics, or similar)
  • Highly structured and organized—you enjoy clean systems and clear definitions
  • Strong logical, analytical thinking, and problem-solving skills
  • Comfortable working with data (Excel/Google Sheets; bonus if you like building models)
  • Interest in automation; programming/algorithms experience is a strong plus (e.g., Python, JavaScript, SQL, or similar)
  • Clear communication and ability to collaborate with Sales, Marketing, and other stakeholders
  • English proficiency (written and spoken) is important in a global team environment
  • Available for 30 hours/week from Toradex Office in Campinas/SP

Nice-to-haves (you can also learn on the job)

  • HubSpot experience (CRM, pipelines, workflows, reporting)
  • Power BI experience (dashboards, data modeling)
  • Familiarity with CRM concepts (lifecycle stages, lead scoring, attribution, pipeline management)

What you'll gain

  • Real-world experience improving Sales Ops for a growing cloud offering
  • Ownership of meaningful projects with measurable impact
  • Exposure to modern revenue operations (Sales + Marketing Ops alignment)
  • Mentoring and collaboration in an international team

What we offer:

  • An agile and inter-cultural work environment
  • Working with latest IoT computer technology in an international environment
  • Participation in defining processes and your working environment
  • Contemporary employment conditions, modern office space and a flexible working environment
  • Opportunities for your personal development
  • Meal allowance (flash card)
  • Flexible working hours
  • Parking space
  • Anniversary day off

How to apply

Send your CV in english and a short note about why you're interested in the role, also If you have examples (dashboards, scripts, small automation projects), include them

Toradex is a leader in embedded computing, serving innovative products to industrial, medical, automotive & IoT companies creating feature-rich & intelligent systems for demanding applications, e.g. supercars, self-driving tractors, patient monitoring systems – to name a few.

We provide effective & robust embedded computing solutions and strive for the best development experience in the industry with a focus on intelligent hardware design, innovative software solutions & free comprehensive support. Our relationship with our customers ensures that we all succeed and it allows us to participate in the realization of incredible new products. Our products are directly sold to more than 3'000 industrial customers in over 70 different countries worldwide.

title: Spatial Designer
description:
A Just Live é uma agência de Live Marketing que atua em projetos de alto volume e alta complexidade, conectando estratégia e execução para entregar experiências de marca memoráveis. Nosso ambiente é dinâmico, colaborativo e marcado pela proximidade entre as áreas. Tão importante quanto a paixão por criar experiências é o desejo de construir uma história duradoura conosco.

Nossa Cultura
Amor: ter amor pelo que faz e pela sua escolha profissional. Ser feliz com o seu trabalho e estar seguro em sua área sempre.

Foco: Estar disposto a trabalhar com disciplina e muito foco, vencendo dificuldades, aprendendo e evoluindo constantemente.

Sonho: Ter a certeza de que o sonho que construímos aqui, todos os dias, nos permitirá sonhar cada vez mais. Não tenha medo, a vida é muito mais alegre sonhando e o sentimento de poder realizar é único. Seja ele qual for.

Time: Trabalhar sempre como equipe, confiando que juntos somos mais fortes e muito melhores. Equilibrar nossas diferenças para perpetuar nossa união.

Dono: Nunca esquecer que construímos projetos juntos, o que nos torna todos donos. Seja no momento de reconhecimento e conquistas, ou quando for preciso gerenciar crises e fazer o impossível para entregarmos nossos trabalhos.

Você: Ter a consciência de que, aqui, você pode se tornar um ser humano ainda melhor. E, mais do que isso, pode ajudar a formar seres humanos melhores. Deixando o ego de lado, pensando no próximo e acreditando que a mudança deve começar pela gente.

Sobre a Vaga:
Buscamos um(a)
Spatial Designer
criativo(a) e talentoso(a) para atuar no desenvolvimento de ambientes, espaços e experiências físicas para projetos de live marketing, eventos, ativações de marca, feiras, estandes e experiências de marca. Será responsável por traduzir conceitos criativos em projetos espaciais, funcionais e executáveis, com foco em desenhos em escala, layouts técnicos e peças vetoriais, garantindo a correta interpretação pelos times de produção e fornecedores.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Desenvolver conceitos espaciais e layouts para eventos, ativações, estandes, cenografia e projetos especiais;
  • Produzir materiais vetoriais para projetos de ambiente (layouts, sinalização, aplicação de marca no espaço);
  • Traduzir o conceito criativo (KV, narrativa, branding) em organização espacial, fluxo e experiência do público;
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com o restante da criação, além da produção e do planejamento;
  • Apoiar o time de produção com descritivos técnicos, medidas, especificações e materiais;
  • Ajustar projetos conforme restrições técnicas, orçamentárias e operacionais;
  • Participar de brainstorms, alinhamentos criativos e apresentações internas;
  • Garantir clareza e precisão técnica dos materiais enviados para execução.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Formação em Design, Design de Interiores, Arquitetura, Design de Ambientes ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência prévia com eventos, live marketing, cenografia, feiras ou projetos temporários;
  • Domínio total de ferramentas de desenho vetorial e layout, como Illustrator;
  • Domínio de escala, proporção e leitura de plantas;
  • Conhecimento avançado em Adobe Photoshop;
  • Organização, atenção a detalhes e boa comunicação;
  • Capacidade de trabalhar com prazos curtos e múltiplos projetos simultâneos;
  • Conhecimento na plataforma google como slides, sheets, doc;
  • Compreender necessidades e expectativas dos Stakeholders - clientes, agencias parceiras, times externos.

Desejável:

  • Experiência em agência de live marketing ou eventos;
  • Conhecimento de materiais cenográficos, estruturas, marcenaria e sinalização;
  • Inglês como diferencial.

title: Torizon Cloud Developer
description:
Toradex
is a global company strongly focused on engineering & technology. We're powered by a diverse & uniquely gifted workforce. We pursue the best people to propel our innovative vision of embedded computing and IoT. If you're interested in being a driving force at an agile technology company, engineering clever computing solutions & helping other companies bring their products to life, we should talk.

Toradex is a leading provider of embedded computing solutions, specializing in powerful, reliable, and easy-to-use hardware and software for IoT, industrial automation, medical devices, and other verticals. With a focus on high-quality, reliability, ease-of-use, and a strong developer experience, Toradex offers a range of System on Modules (SoMs), accompanying accessories and carrier boards, customization services, a full-stack software offering facilitating cyber regulations compliance, and much more. Headquartered in Switzerland, with offices across the globe, Toradex is committed to empowering developers and businesses by delivering innovative, high-quality solutions that reduce complexity and accelerate time to market.

Toradex's Brazil office hosts parts of the Global Sales, Marketing, and R&D teams, composed of several engineers working on diverse tasks with global reach. Toradex teams are mission-oriented, high-performing collaborative, and empowered to innovate & improve products & services (including open-source projects) for the benefit of our customers and the industry.

Job Description
As a Torizon Cloud Developer, you will work with other members of a small geographically distributed team to build and maintain all aspects of the Torizon Cloud product. You will have a high level of autonomy and impact on the product. You will closely collaborate with other teams in R&D to release cross-team products.

Roles & Responsibilities:

  • Implement features and follow their deployment through to production
  • Create and communicate software design to other members of team (and R&D)
  • Take part in designs and work with other team-members to shape the product
  • Participate in technical design reviews and code reviews
  • Work in 2-week sprint cadence

Requirements

  • Hold a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Engineering/ Computer Science, or equivalent.
  • Availability to work from the Toradex Office in Campinas/SP in a hybrid model.
  • Detail-oriented and capable of managing multiple tasks simultaneously.
  • 5 years professional experience as a software developer working with related technology.
  • Ability and passion to learn new technologies, and develop skills in modern cloud technologies.
  • Ability to work both independently and collaboratively within a team-oriented environment.
  • Understand REST API standards and best practices.
  • Experience with Git.
  • Knowledge of programming patterns and anti-patterns.
  • Experience using databases and familiar with best-practices.
  • Programming language experience:

Scala

Golang

  • Knowledge of at least one Shell Scripting Language, such as Bash, Python, or Ruby.
  • Strong proficiency in English with excellent written and verbal communication skills

Nice to Have:

  • Strong Scala experience, or experience with other functional programming languages.
  • Experience designing/architecting software systems in a micro-service architecture.
  • Experience developing applications in a micro-service architecture.
  • Experience with AWS, Kubernetes, IaC, and Container technologies.
  • Experience with Kafka, MQTT, and various other message-bus systems.
  • Experience creating a REST API.
  • Experience creating CICD pipelines.
  • Proven passion for learning new technologies and exploring new frameworks.
  • Passion for end-to-end problem solving and working collaboratively with others.
  • Maintainer of open-source project.

What we Offer:

  • An agile and inter-cultural work environment
  • Working with latest cloud technologies in an international environment
  • Learning state of the art technology in a fast-paced environment
  • Mentorship from senior team-members
  • Opportunity to be part of industry disruptive technology
  • Work alongside a close-knit, respectful, and fun team
  • Flexible working schedule
  • Contemporary employment conditions, modern office space and a flexible working environment
  • Opportunities for your personal development
  • Meal allowance (flash card)
  • Health and dental care
  • Parking space
  • Anniversary day off

Desired Candidate Profile
Toradex is a dynamic, fun and exciting work environment. We are looking for somebody who has similar values, is passionate about their work, and motivated to learn new things. We try to constantly improve and expect the same from you. The cloud team is a geographically distributed team which requires a high level of communication and autonomy, the candidate is expected to be a "self starter" and be capable of managing ones time effectively.

Toradex is a leader in embedded computing, serving innovative products to industrial, medical, automotive & IoT companies creating feature-rich & intelligent systems for demanding applications, e.g. supercars, self-driving tractors, patient monitoring systems – to name a few.

We provide effective & robust embedded computing solutions and strive for the best development experience in the industry with a focus on intelligent hardware design, innovative software solutions & free comprehensive support. Our relationship with our customers ensures that we all succeed and it allows us to participate in the realization of incredible new products. Our products are directly sold to more than 3'000 industrial customers in over 70 different countries worldwide.

title: Operations Manager
description:
Job Summary

The Operations Manager is responsible for overseeing and optimizing day-to-day manufacturing operations to ensure efficient production, high-quality output, cost control, and compliance with safety and regulatory standards. This role plays a critical part in improving operational performance, managing cross-functional teams, and driving continuous improvement across the manufacturing facility.

Key Responsibilities

Operations & Production

  • Oversee daily manufacturing operations to ensure production targets, quality standards, and delivery timelines are met
  • Develop and implement operational plans to improve efficiency, productivity, and throughput
  • Coordinate production scheduling, capacity planning, and resource allocation

Process Improvement

  • Identify inefficiencies and lead continuous improvement initiatives (Lean, Six Sigma, Kaizen, etc.)
  • Analyze KPIs and operational data to drive performance improvements
  • Implement best practices to reduce waste, downtime, and operational costs

People Management

  • Lead, coach, and develop production supervisors and operational teams
  • Foster a culture of accountability, teamwork, and continuous improvement
  • Support recruitment, training, and performance management of operations staff

Quality, Safety & Compliance

  • Ensure compliance with health, safety, environmental, and regulatory requirements
  • Maintain quality control standards and work closely with QA/QC teams
  • Drive a strong safety culture and ensure incident reporting and corrective actions

Supply Chain & Stakeholder Collaboration

  • Collaborate with procurement, logistics, maintenance, and planning teams to ensure smooth operations
  • Manage inventory levels to support production while minimizing excess stock
  • Work closely with senior leadership to align operational goals with business strategy

Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Manufacturing, Operations Management, or related field
  • 10 years of experience in a manufacturing operations role, with at least 5 years in a management position
  • Strong understanding of manufacturing processes, production planning, and quality systems
  • Experience with continuous improvement methodologies (Lean, Six Sigma preferred)

Skills & Competencies

  • Strong leadership and people management skills
  • Excellent problem-solving and analytical abilities
  • Proven ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills
  • Proficiency in ERP/MRP systems and operational reporting tools

Reafirmamos nosso compromisso com a diversidade, equidade e inclusão, incentivando a candidatura de pessoas com deficiência, neurodivergentes, mulheres, LGBTI+, de diversas etnias, gerações e corpos, além de outros grupos socialmente marginalizados.

No Centro Nacional de Pesquisa em Energia e Materiais (CNPEM), somos movidos pela paixão pela ciência. Nosso ambiente é um vibrante centro de pesquisa e desenvolvimento, onde profissionais de diversas especialidades se conectam para enfrentar desafios complexos e criar soluções para problemas relevantes, especialmente nas áreas de saúde, energia, materiais renováveis e sustentabilidade.

Somos uma Organização Social supervisionada pelo Ministério da Ciência, Tecnologia e Inovação (MCTI), na vanguarda da pesquisa científica no Brasil. Somos responsáveis pelo Sirius, a maior infraestrutura científica já construída no País, e atualmente, desenvolvemos o projeto Orion, um complexo laboratorial dedicado a pesquisas avançadas em patógenos, que estará disponível para a comunidade científica nacional e internacional.

Oferecemos uma ampla gama de oportunidades de carreira para profissionais de diferentes perfis. No CNPEM, conduzimos pesquisas de ponta que abrangem nanotecnologia, biociências, biotecnologia, biorrenováveis, instrumentação científica e física de aceleradores, conduzidas, respectivamente, pelos Laboratórios Nacionais de Nanotecnologia (LNNano), Biociências (LNBio), Biorrenováveis (LNBR) e Luz Síncrotron (LNLS). Essas iniciativas são fortalecidas por projetos tecnológicos desafiadores e pela busca de soluções na fronteira das engenharias, liderados pela Diretoria Adjunta de Tecnologia (DAT).

Todo esse ecossistema é sustentado por uma rede integrada de áreas estratégicas que inclui tecnologia da informação, comunicação, gestão de projetos, assessoria jurídica & compliance, recursos humanos, finanças, compras, sustentabilidade e inovação, alocadas entre Diretoria Geral (DG) e Diretoria de Serviços Compartilhados (DSC). A Diretoria Adjunta de Infraestrutura (DAI) assegura a manutenção das instalações, o suporte à engenharia e o desenvolvimento arquitetônico, criando condições ideais para o avanço de todas as atividades.

A Ilum Escola de Ciência complementa essas frentes com um curso de bacharelado em Ciência e Tecnologia, oferecendo uma formação inovadora que prepara novas gerações de cientistas para os desafios do futuro.

Acreditamos que o sucesso é alcançado por meio de dedicação, colaboração e propósito claro. Valorizamos o desenvolvimento contínuo dos nossos profissionais e estudantes, oferecendo um ambiente inspirador e favorável para o crescimento profissional e pessoal.

Estamos comprometidos com a sustentabilidade e buscamos soluções que promovam um futuro mais verde. Prezamos pelo cuidado e bem-estar de nossos colaboradores, ao mesmo tempo em que valorizamos a diversidade e promovemos um ambiente inclusivo, onde todas as pessoas são bem-vindas e respeitadas.

Se você é apaixonado por ciência e busca um lugar onde você possa fazer a diferença, junte-se a nós no CNPEM.

title: Estágio Técnico Hospital Veterinário
description:
O Grupo Petz tem como premissa a pluralidade. Por isso, as diferenças são essenciais para a construção de um ecossistema criativo, inovador e descomplicado. Não à toa, somos o maior ecossistema pet do Brasil. Pessoas e empresas diversas atuando juntas em prol do bem-estar animal. Se você se identifica e quer construir sua história com um time descomplicado, proativo, focado em resultados e, principalmente, apaixonado por pets, candidate-se. Aqui, queremos que você seja você, para juntos sermos Petz. Buscamos um(a) profissional para:

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Auxiliar os enfermeiros e veterinários em consulta;
  • Auxiliar na reposição de medicamentos e materiais hospitalares;
  • Auxiliar nas aplicações de medicamentos;
  • Auxiliar na aferição dos principais parâmetros vitais;
  • Auxiliar no manejo alimentar a sanitário dos animais;
  • Auxiliar no atendimento aos proprietários dos animais internados;
  • Auxiliar no acompanhamento de consultas.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino Superior Cursando em Medicina Veterinária;
  • Disponibilidade para estagiar em escala 6X1 (30 Horas Semanais);
  • Horário do estágio 17h ás 22h;

Informações adicionais

Assistência Odontológica

Disponível em até 30 dias após a admissão, garantindo seu bem-estar desde o início.

Clube de Descontos Petz

Descontos e cashbacks exclusivos com mais de 700 parceiros em todo o Brasil. Economia no que realmente importa

Day Off de Aniversário

Você merece comemorar Ganhe uma folga no mês do seu aniversário (disponível após 6 meses de empresa).

GymPass ou TotalPass

Acesso a academias, estúdios e atividades de bem-estar após 30 dias de empresa.

Indica Petz

Indique amigos para trabalhar com a gente e ganhe recompensas exclusivas. Quem indica, brilha

Parceria com o SESC

Descontos, atividades culturais, esportivas e acesso a programas de lazer por todo o Brasil.

Seguro de Vida

Para garantir segurança e tranquilidade a você e sua família.

UniPetz

Nossa plataforma de desenvolvimento online, para você aprender e crescer no seu ritmo.

Vale Alimentação

Benefício concedido de acordo com a política vigente da sua regional.

Auxílio Transporte

Garantimos o seu deslocamento com tranquilidade e responsabilidade.

A Petz tem como propósito criar valor e proporcionar a melhor experiência possível na relação entre o pet e o seu tutor. E, para que isso seja possível, temos como visão sermos reconhecidos mundialmente, até 2025, como o melhor ecossistema do segmento pet.

Com uma estratégia omnicanal e que integra não só os canais físicos e digitais, mas também os segmentos de produtos e serviços, somos uma plataforma de soluções completa para os animais de estimação.

Nossa proposta é oferecer aos nossos clientes uma experiência de compra e atendimento diferenciado em nossas lojas físicas, além de agilidade e conveniência em nossos canais digitais. Sim, queremos estar presentes em todos os momentos da vida dos nossos clientes, tutores e pets.

Contamos, também, com a maior rede de centros de estética do Brasil e, sob a marca Seres, com a mais abrangente rede de centros veterinários do país; além de, por meio do maior programa nacional de adoção de cães e gatos, o Adote Petz, fomentamos a criação da conexão emocional do tutor com o seu novo melhor amigo.

E ainda nem falamos dos produtos da marca Petz, que já são mais de 300 itens disponíveis em todas as nossas lojas, sendo líder de vendas nas 25 categorias de produtos ofertados. Com um faturamento que cresce mais de 40% ao ano, isso mostra o quanto somos fortes, inovadores e entregamos produtos de qualidade aos nossos clientes.

E, aos poucos, esse ecossistema vem se expandindo e se fortalecendo com a chegada de grandes marcas do segmento junto ao grupo Petz, dentre elas: Zee.Dog, Cansei de Ser Gato, Cão Cidadão e Petix. Legal né?

A estratégia de omnicanalidade nos trouxe até aqui, e assim nos tornamos líderes de mercado e também uma empresa que dobra de tamanho a cada dois anos. Mas somos incansáveis e sabemos que há muito a ser feito, para isso, estamos investindo em fortalecer ainda mais o nosso ecossistema de serviços, produtos e contratação de gente melhor que a gente para continuar alcançando voos ainda mais altos e resultados expressivos.

E você, quer fazer parte deste time de pessoas apaixonadas por pets? Trabalhar num ambiente descomplicado e acolhedor, no qual respeitamos uns aos outros? Onde reconhecemos seus esforços e premiamos resultados? E principalmente, encantamos nossos clientes e temos prazer em servir?

Se você respondeu sim para todas essas perguntas, então vem fazer parte do #EcossistemaPetz #SomosPetz.

title: HR Assistant
description:

About SABIS

SABIS is a global education network that has an active presence in 21 countries on five continents and educates students in both the private and public sectors. SABIS schools implement the proven, proprietary SABIS Educational System, which has been developed and refined for over 135 years.

All students in the SABIS Network benefit from a long tradition of excellence in education, a reputation that is rooted in a well-developed philosophy that seeks to provide students with a top-quality education that prepares them to meet the challenges of a changing world.

For more information about the SABIS Network, visit:

Job Purpose

Providing support to the HR department through the implementation of HR policies, procedures and processes, as well as other support tasks in recruitment, and departmental administration, to contribute to the smooth and efficient running of various functions within the HR department.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Updating and posting online vacancies on recruitment portals and company career webpage (SABIS Careers), screening and shortlisting resumes, sending qualified applications and scheduling interviews with the line managers in order to support the school staffing needs.
  • Documenting feedback related to applicants in order to keep a reliable record.
  • Contributing to candidate sourcing: coordinating job fairs and related activities; networking with some university placement offices.
  • Conducting interviews for local and expatriate non-native positions, as and when required.
  • Liaising with the hiring managers for interview feedbacks, transfers, candidates' status, etc. and updating applicants' information on SABIS Careers accordingly.
  • Updating the recruitment database for CVs collected from external sources to maintain records of them for current and/or future vacancies.
  • Managing all communication and paperwork associated with new recruits, including, but not limited to, the issuance of the letter of intent, the contract, application form, confidentiality/waiver agreement, and reference check collecting and assembling all documents for the personnel file and keeping all relevant parties informed as needed.

title: Senior Critical Environment Operations
description:
Overview
As a Senior Critical Environment Technician (CET) in Microsoft's Cloud Operations & Innovation (CO+I) team, you will maintain the critical infrastructure that keeps our Datacenters up and running. This could be anything from coordinating with supplier/vendors, working closely with Management to address operational, risk and safety situations, mentoring other CE Technicians, having a hands-on understanding on how critical environment equipment works, performing various types of maintenance, responding to onsite incidents while coordinating with other critical facilities professionals, and using telemetry and other platforms to monitor equipment performance and operations.

Microsoft's Cloud Operations & Innovation (CO+I) is the engine that powers our cloud services. As a CO+I Critical Environment Technician, you will perform a key role in delivering the core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft's online services including Bing, Office 365, Xbox, OneDrive, and the Microsoft Azure platform. As a group, CO+I is focused on the personal and professional development of all employees and offers training and opportunities including Career Rotation Programs, Diversity & Inclusion training and events, and professional certifications.

Our infrastructure is comprised of a large global portfolio of more than 200 datacenters in 32 countries and millions of servers. Our foundation is built upon and managed by a team of subject matter experts working to support services for more than 1 billion customers and 20 million businesses in over 90 countries worldwide.

With environmental sustainability and optimization at the forefront of our datacenter design and operations, we continue to grow and evolve as we meet the ever-changing business demands that hold Microsoft as a world-class cloud provider.

Microsoft's mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

In this environment, you may be asked to go on business travel to support other metros periodically, 0-25% of the time, including shift assignments during non-standard business hours that may include evening, nighttime, weekends and/or holidays.

Responsibilities
Critical Environment Culture

  • Understands, follows, and ensures safety and security requirements (e.g., job hazard assessments (JHAs), toolbox talks), and business processes and procedures are met, to properly perform work in a safe, quality, and reliable manner in accordance to applicable Authority Having Jurisdiction (AHJ) regulations, and Microsoft requirements. Recognizes safe versus unsafe working conditions and responds accordingly (e.g., stop/pause tasks, stand down vendors where necessary). Escalates immediately when unsafe working conditions are observed and promotes a safe working culture to empower less experienced team members. Participates in required meetings, trainings, and necessary handoffs. Proactively assesses and shares current and emerging security threats in safety discussions and shares best practices to address or mitigate risk. Assesses and identifies appropriate resources and equipment necessary to fully support environmental health and safety (EHS) objectives. Actively maintains safe working conditions at all times. Proactively ensures safety and security requirements are followed and met for the work of themselves and others.

Equipment and Systems Maintenance

  • Processes method statement of work (MSOW) documents. Coordinates activities and associated schedules with contractors. Performs inspections of equipment in a facility. Participates in testing and commissioning activities. Advises engineer partners or project management colleagues on project scope process or execution methodology. Presents for review and approval MSOW in their area of responsibility.
  • Prepares and submits highly complex reports as assigned following preexisting scripts and templates, or using ad hoc methods required to support trending and analysis (e.g., Root Cause Analysis (RCA) reports) and may review prior reports delivered by less experienced team members. Develops methods of operating procedure (MOPs), standard operating procedures (SOPs), and/or digital methods of operating procedures (DMOPs) for highly complex and/or interdependent equipment and disciplines to ensure safe and reliable execution. Reviews completed work using approved tools and procedural templates from less experienced technicians for accuracy and completeness. Completes and provides coaching to support less experienced technicians for mandatory, technical, and procedural training assignments. Analyzes findings from reports and documents observations.
  • Performs various types of maintenance (e.g., planned, predictive, corrective) and repairs for multiple disciplines and multiple equipment types of increasing complexity with no supervision, while serving as a subject matter expert for one discipline - in consideration of Task Hazard Analysis (THA), Method Statement of Work (MSOW), or varying permit requirements. Incorporates security governance frameworks into maintenance practices and drives continuous security improvements. Communicates and/or escalates maintenance activities per established process and procedure. Prioritizes maintenance activities as required and/or appropriate. Documents tasks or issues during maintenance activities within appropriate systems per process and procedure as needed. Provides consultation to colleagues on maintenance and repairs through deep understanding of equipment, systems and their interrelations. Follows recommended maintenance schedules. Oversees everyday, complex, large-scale tasks for a single discipline or equipment across disciplines. Ensures follow up action items are addressed in a timely manner. Masters the maintenance of all systems and equipment in a safe and professional manner and understands levels of risk (LORs) associated with varying types of maintenance across all disciplines. Plans, coordinates, and presents maintenance items for review and approval in their area of responsibility. Serves as an expert on applying security principles to ensure all systems are protected against unauthorized access during maintenance.
  • Acts as a subject matter expert, performing troubleshooting independently for multiple equipment, systems, subsystems, and component types. Documents issues found in troubleshooting process within appropriate systems per process and procedure as needed. Ensures equipment and system settings are consistent with established parameters and designs. Determines when troubleshooting efforts are deemed adequate and communicates or escalates to suppliers, engineers, or more experienced colleagues as needed. Has a hands-on understanding of how equipment in all disciplines work and how to troubleshoot to subsystem level. Provides consultation to less experienced colleagues with troubleshooting systems and problems. Oversees less experienced colleagues, or directly troubleshooting systems and investigates root causes. Ensures that security incidents identified during troubleshooting are addressed promptly and escalated as necessary.
  • Provides necessary escort to third-party contractors, sub-contractors, vendors, and service providers on site based on all procedure levels of risk (LOR), enforcing security requirements for all third-party access and operations. Takes part in getting third-party work underway (e.g., making sure systems are properly energized/deenergized), ensuring the work is started and completed in a safe manner in accordance with standard practices, procedures, and Authority Having Jurisdiction (AHJ) regulations. Ensures work performed by suppliers/vendors is performed to scope, all documentation is performed correctly, and escalates as appropriate. Recognizes circumstances when to stop supplier/vendor work to address potential and/or identified concerns. Coordinates across all LOR applicable to preventative and/or corrective maintenance. Identifies and recommends procedure corrections if/when errors are detected or when appropriate. Coordinates and schedules supplier/vendor on-site activities. Coordinates with vendor to schedule maintenance and determines availability of equipment/parts, as directed. Resolves or escalates observed vendor quality issues. May review and approve vendor supplier field service reports, invoices, and work orders.

Equipment and Systems Operations

  • Serves as an expert in the inspection and supervision of critical environment-related facility equipment (e.g., controls, heating, ventilation, and air conditioning (HVAC), mechanical systems), building, and grounds for unsafe or abnormal conditions. Understands critical system alarms for multiple discipline(s) of equipment, their meanings, and engages with appropriate escalation processes or procedures. Recognizes circumstances where execution would be considered safe to proceed. Performs various inspections and validations of equipment performance. Monitors the performance from central monitoring locations (e.g., Facility Operations Centers) of maintenance and operations of equipment (e.g., electrical, mechanical, fire/life safety) and understands risks or impacts to other subsystems across the data center. Escalates per applicable policies and standards. Utilizes telemetry, control systems, and other platforms to monitor site status, analyze past and current events, as well as other processes, and can identify all alarms. Uses technical expertise, prior experience, and device analytics to recognize trends with equipment behavior and checks potential issues as they arise. Advises less experienced colleagues on issues found while monitoring applicable CE systems. Performs all monitoring equipment repair, replacement, and maintenance work, which meets or exceeds Microsoft Service Level Agreement (SLA) requirements. Uses data trends to develop or produce predictive analyses of equipment performance.
  • Safety and quickly responds to and leads an onsite incident response team for all abnormal conditions that impact operations, and coordinates with other critical facilities professionals to perform corrective repairs, without supervision. Gathers necessary information and creates incident timelines/data, root-cause analyses, and/or action items following an abnormal condition as required. Identifies and contacts/engages appropriate parties and security points of contact to mitigate incidents as they occur. Develops new or follows preexisting emergency operating procedures (EOPs), methods of procedure (MOPs), standard operating procedures (SOPs), and digital methods of operating procedures (DMOPs) in relation to incidents. Directly provides and/or leads and coordinates emergency monitoring response plans for irregular or malfunctioning conditions. Serves as technical expert in ensuring emergency operating procedures (EOPs) are consistent with proper incident response.
  • Works on complex, advanced tasks (e.g., stabilization, resolution, recovery) independently. Serves as a subject matter expert in critical environments-related systems within the data center, advises less experienced colleagues on such topics, and provides oversight and training/mentorship to team members on tasks regarding these subsystems (e.g., electrical, mechanical, controls, generators). Serves as a resource for less experienced team members to incorporate security-first principles into daily tasks, ensuring all equipment operations prioritize identifying potential security threats and mitigating them immediately. Demonstrates an understanding of and operates equipment and systems across all disciplines (e.g., electrical, mechanical, controls) with knowledge of the interactions between them and overall operation of a data center. Operates all systems and equipment in a safe and professional manner in alignment with Microsoft standards.
  • Utilizes internal computerized maintenance management system (CMMS) to track all equipment assets and to complete work order requests for maintenance work in accordance with all Microsoft security policies. Tracks hours for performed tasks within applicable task management systems. Tracks utilization and time tracking results for team members, within applicable task management systems, as needed. Guides and coaches team in CMMS usage best practices. Adds required data, documents, logs changes, and upkeeps procedures related to building management systems and reports. Properly signals spare equipment and parts utilization within maintenance work orders.

Physical Requirements

  • Applies to but is not limited to US-based Data Center roles: Occasional climbing of ladders. Frequent climbing of stairs and/or ramps. Prolonged standing. Occasional lifting 50lbs / 22.5kg. Occasional push or pull 50-75 lbs / kg. with assistive device. Normal visual acuity (near, far and peripheral with correction), defined via standard medical terms and applicable criteria. Normal color vision for electrical work, defined via standard medical terms and applicable criteria.

Working Conditions

  • Applies to but is not limited to US-based Data Center roles: Working for extended periods under elevated levels of ambient noise, heat, and light due to necessary equipment and ventilation systems.
  • As indicated above, this role has a travel requirement of up to 25% which means you may be required to travel, from time to time, as part of this role

Other

  • Embody our culture and values

Qualifications
Required Qualifications

  • High School Diploma, GED, or equivalent AND 3+ years mission critical services work/applied learning experience (e.g., high availability assembly/manufacturing/critical infrastructure environments such as data centers, oil and gas refineries, hospitals, pharmaceutical, manufacturing, or related fields) OR equivalent experience.
  • 1+ year(s) experience in a specialized area (e.g., mechanical field, electrical field, controls field) or related field
  • Ability to speak, write and understand fluent English

Background Check Requirements

  • Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include, but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings:
  • Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.

While not required, we also look for the following
Preferred Qualifications

  • High School Diploma, GED, or equivalent AND 5+ years mission critical services experience (e.g., high-availability assembly/manufacturing/critical infrastructure environments such as data centers, oil and gas refineries, hospitals, pharmaceutical, manufacturing, or related fields)

  • OR Associate's Degree or technical trade certification (e.g., military, trade school), or higher-equivalent education AND 4+ years mission-critical services experience (e.g., high-availability assembly/manufacturing/critical infrastructure environments such as data centers, oil and gas refineries, hospitals, pharmaceutical, manufacturing, or related fields)

  • OR equivalent experience.

This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. If you need assistance with religious accommodations and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application process, read more about
requesting accommodations.

Descrição da vaga

The role is responsible for
conducting the analytics processes and methodologies that support key Route to Market (RTM) initiatives
aimed at identifying opportunities to optimize the distribution network and operational RTM strategies. These projects are based on RTM assessments that form part of an ongoing analytics cycle, which begins with a comprehensive RTM and performance analysis across business units. Based on these findings, priority projects are scoped, planned, and executed.

This position will lead the development and management of the RTM analytics foundation, which underpins performance diagnostics and preliminary network evaluations. Once a network optimization initiative is launched, this role will be accountable for the preparation and data collection phase and will provide support during model calibration and optimization.

  • Proven experience in Supply Chain or Commercial Analytics roles, with prior involvement in data-driven projects.

  • Cross-functional collaboration and ability to interact with stakeholders across different levels and geographies.
  • Ownership, autonomy, and resilience to navigate evolving priorities and shifting environment while still being able to focus on deliver the commitments.
  • Fluency in English.
  • Continuously monitor the analytics process to identify opportunities for simplification, automation, and efficiency gains—allowing greater focus on insight generation and decision support.

description:
Work model:
On-site
| Location:
Campinas/SP

About Us
AB InBev is the leading global brewer and one of the world's top 5 consumer product companies. With over 500 beer brands, we're number one or two in many of the world's top beer markets, including North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia, and Africa.

About AB InBev Growth Group
Created in 2022, the Growth Group unifies our business-to-business (B2B), direct-to-consumer (DTC), Sales & Distribution, and Marketing teams. By bringing together global tech and commercial functions, the Growth Group allows us to fully leverage data and drive digital transformation and organic growth for AB InBev around the world.

In addition to supporting well known global beer brands like Corona, Budweiser and Michelob Ultra, the Growth Group is home to a robust suite of digital products including our B2B digital commerce platform BEES, on-demand delivery services Ze Delivery and TaDa Delivery, and table top beer keg PerfectDraft.

We are an exceptional team, focused on understanding and supporting consumer and customer needs, harnessing new technology, and scaling growth opportunities.

About The Role
We're looking for a strategic and highly organized culture and communications analyst to join our Internal Communications team. In this role, you'll help bring our culture, strategy, and priorities to life through clear, inspiring, and actionable communication. You'll partner closely with teams across the business to support major initiatives, craft storytelling moments that engage employees, and support change communications that drive understanding and alignment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Collaborate across teams to support performance and rewards processes, employee engagement programs, and org structure and tech stack changes.
  • Support development of communications plans, messaging, and execution.
  • Write and edit internal messages, presentations, and updates across comms channels with clarity and consistency.
  • Coordinate across a diverse group of stakeholders including legal, finance, tech, and facilities to drive deliverables.
  • Partner with People teams to amplify culture, learning, career growth, talent, and hiring initiatives.
  • Develop FAQs, talking points, templates, and toolkits that help stakeholders communicate effectively.
  • Partner with business stakeholders to amplify results, our work and recognition.

Capabilities & Skills

  • Strategic thinker who can connect communications to business goals.
  • Excellent writer and editor with strong storytelling instincts in both English and Portuguese.
  • Highly collaborative with proven ability to build relationships across levels and functions.
  • Organized and able to manage multiple projects in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong attention to detail, with a bias toward action and problem-solving.
  • Comfortable working with senior stakeholders and influencing with confidence.
  • Skilled at creating data-driven comms plans and strategies.

Basic Qualifications

  • Experience in internal communications, employee engagement, or related field.
  • Background in large, fast-paced, or matrixed organizations preferred.
  • Skilled in PowerPoint and Microsoft Teams; experience designing SharePoint sites, or internal communication tools.

description:
A Cargill é uma empresa familiar comprometida em oferecer soluções alimentares e agrícolas para nutrir o mundo de forma segura, responsável e sustentável. Estamos no centro da cadeia de suprimentos, colaborando com produtores e clientes para obter, fabricar e entregar produtos essenciais para a vida.Ao fornecer aos clientes os elementos essenciais da vida, possibilitamos o crescimento das empresas, a prosperidade das comunidades e uma vida melhor para os consumidores.

 #LI-EV1

Isso mesmo, o Hub de Tecnologia da Ambev

Somos responsáveis por impulsionar a transformação digital da Ambev. Contamos com cerca de 50 Squads, que atuam em mais de 100 produtos, e cada linha de código criada aqui conecta nossa paixão por tecnologia aos mais diversos brindes e suas razões.

Do campo ao copo, entregamos soluções simples e escaláveis usando tecnologia de ponta para transformar o dia a dia de milhares de pessoas. E isso só é possível graças a um time incrível que faz acontecer, com inovação, senso de dono e muito orgulho de ser tech.

Muitas das nossas soluções são escaladas para a Ambev Global Tech, hub de tecnologia da Anheuser-Busch InBev (AB InBev), multinacional de bebidas e cervejas, e para outras unidades de negócio da companhia. NOSSO JEITO TECH DE SER

QUER TRABALHAR COM A GENTE?

Para atuar na Ambev Tech com projetos nacionais, temos unidades em Blumenau (SC), Maringá (PR), São Paulo (SP) e Jaguariúna (SP), e contamos também com um time remoto em vários cantos do Brasil e América Latina. QUEREMOS QUE VOCÊ VOE CADA VEZ MAIS ALTO

Somos uma das maiores empresas aeroespaciais do mundo graças à dedicação de pessoas que possuem uma paixão genuína por superar o impossível. Foi assim desde o início e seguimos norteados pelo desejo de encontrar pessoas que vivem pelo desafio.

Nascemos do sonho de transformar o Brasil em um país com a mais alta tecnologia. Quando tudo parecia impossível, sonhamos alto e nossos profissionais fizeram a companhia alcançar novas altitudes. Não há outra maneira de descrever o que nos impulsiona: Desafiar, Criar e Superar.

O nosso sonho continua e acreditamos que todo mundo tem potencial para fazer a diferença. Por isso, cada vez mais, buscamos construir times diversos, que sejam representativos e valorizem a história e as singularidades de todas as pessoas, para que elas possam viver os seus sonhos junto com a gente.
